newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus police seek missing rare Swatch watches.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus police seek missing rare Swatch watches.

text.p: Police in Cyprus said on Thursday they were cooperating with Interpol to find the thieves of a shipment of rare Swatch watches on a world tour.
The 1,600 watches were missing from a container opened in the presence of customs agents in Nicosia earlier this week.
Only one watch and empty display cases were left. The limited edition watches were on a world tour organised by Swatch.

"This museum of watches goes all around the world and it was in Cyprus for the first time," said a representative of the Cyprus agent of Swatch, Michalis Michaelides."Unfortunately when it arrived all watches with the exception of one was missing."
The Cyprus agents of Swatch valued the watches at around 200,000 pounds ($395,000). Cyprus police had earlier put their value at 90,000 pounds.
The container arrived at the port of Limassol on March 13 from Venice. "The seals on the container were untouched," a police spokesman said.
